title: Correspondance de Pierre Bayle (édition électronique)
author: Pierre Bayle
institution: Université Jean Monnet Saint-Étienne, IHRIM (directed by Antony McKenna and Fabienne Vial-Bonacci)
notes: Critical edition of the letters sent and received by Pierre Bayle (1647-1706), with transcriptions, annotations, indexes and translations of Latin letters. The site publishes letters 1-1405 (volumes I-XI of the printed edition, 1662-1698); volumes XII-XIV (letters up to 1791 and 1706) are not online. Counts are ours: 1,402 letters listed on the site, all dated before 1699, and about 1.25 million words counted on each letter page without the editorial notes (approximate). The site mentions TEI/XML output but no files are public. The site was updated in 2025.
